title: The Hanford DFLAW registry separates fourteen named process, asset, custody, and disposal stages
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Environmental Management
summary: FTFN now maintains 14 ordered DFLAW lifecycle nodes from tank retrieval through TSCR, AP-106, laboratory certification, LAW processing, two named melters, container handling, shipment, IDF staging, and final disposal. Denominator: Fourteen public process or custody nodes derived from DOE and regulator records, each with a stable stage key and explicit input/output relation.
